name: Alan Armstrong
bio: Alan Stuart Armstrong is an American businessman and politician serving since 2026 as the junior United States senator from Oklahoma. A member of the Republican Party, he was the CEO of the oil and gas company Williams from 2011 to 2025. Governor Kevin Stitt appointed Armstrong to the Senate after Markwayne Mullin resigned to become secretary of homeland security, having never held office before his appointment.
